findings.title: Pause during async context preparation still dispatches a new provider request
findings.test: pause during async transform does not start a new provider request
findings.actual: Provider calls 1 after pause request arrived inside transformContext; expected 0.
findings.impact: A new provider request may begin after pause even though no in-flight model stream needed settling.
findings.fix: Fence at the actual streamFunction dispatch after awaited transform, conversion and API-key preparation, while preserving the stopped request context.

findings.title: Deferred CustomMessage is flushed into an unfinished tool batch and makes resume fail
findings.test: session pause keeps deferred custom message out of incomplete tool batch
findings.actual: Public sendCustomMessage(triggerTurn:false) while tool one runs; pause checkpoint pendingCustom=0 with assistant/toolResult/custom; resume sets error Resumable tool batch has unexpected trailing message, effects remain [one]. Unpaused control executes [one,two].
findings.impact: An ordinary deferred context message prevents the remaining tool from ever running.
findings.fix: Keep pending custom and bash messages deferred until the whole assistant tool batch has settled; snapshot their full pending state and restore it passively.

findings.title: Checkpoint loses whole-batch termination and next-action state
tests: resume preserves completed non-terminating result when remaining result terminates
pause after fully terminating tool batch does not add model work on resume
findings.actual: Completed false + remaining true: calls=1 instead of 2. Fully terminated paused batch: calls=2 instead of 1. Both unpaused controls pass.
findings.impact: Resume either omits required continuation or starts unwanted model work; transcript result IDs alone are insufficient scheduling state.
findings.fix: Checkpoint full batch aggregate and pending continuation/finish decision. Resume must evaluate original whole batch and respect already-completed terminal decisions, without rerunning completed effects.

findings.title: Resumed tool batch skips prepareNextTurn before its next model request
findings.test: resume remaining tools invokes prepareNextTurn before the next model
findings.actual: After resumed remaining tool: model calls=2 but prepareNextTurn=0 rather than 1; unpaused control invokes preparation once.
findings.impact: Required context/model/tool refresh is skipped; AgentSession uses this hook for compaction and prompt/tool-loadout preparation.
findings.fix: Carry completedTurn into the next runLoop transition so preparation occurs exactly once before the next request, including after restore.

findings.title: Restore accepts a consumed watermark beyond the next sequence
findings.test: restore rejects watermark greater than next sequence even with empty pending queue
findings.actual: lastConsumedSequence=99, nextSequence=1, empty pending queue is accepted.
findings.impact: Later enqueue/drain can reuse lower sequence numbers and move the consumed watermark backwards, breaking the checkpoint consumption invariant.
findings.fix: Validate both consumed watermarks are strictly below nextSequence even when pending is empty; retain cross-queue pending uniqueness checks.
